/*insertMasterWmGiReleaseTransPopList*/ INSERT INTO WMSIVDT ( WAREHOUSE_CODE, SELLER, INV_NO, INV_SEQ, BUYER, STATUS, SEND_DATE, SEND_TIME, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CONFIRM_DATE, CONFIRM_TIME, BUYER_ITEM_NO, SELLER_ITEM_NO, STDCATLG_ID, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, PROCESS_TYPE, PO_QTY, GR_QTY, INV_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, LIST_PRICE, UNIT_AMT, LIST_AMT, ORIGIN_CODE, MAKER_NAME, AGENT, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, S_INV_NO, S_INV_SEQ, REF_PR_NO, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, DELY_TO_LOCATION, PO_DATE, GR_DATE, INV_DATE, DELIVERY_QTY, DELIVERY_DATE, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_USER_ID, DELIVERY_USER_ID, LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, DELIVERY_COMPANY, DELIVERY_NO , CMS_CATLG_ID, SCHEDULED_DATE, CAR_ID, CAR_NO, CAR_PERSON_NAME, CAR_PERSON_TEL, BOX_QTY ,
DELIVERY_PERSON, TAG_NO ) ( SELECT #{st_warehouse_code} AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, IVDT.SELLER AS SELLER, #{INVK_NO} AS INV_NO, (SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(TO_NUMBER(MAX(WD.INV_SEQ)),0)+1,'FM000000') FROM WMSIVDT WD WHERE WD.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WD.INV_NO = #{INVK_NO} )AS INV_SEQ, IVDT.BUYER AS BUYER, 'C' AS STATUS, '' AS SEND_DATE, '' AS SEND_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CHANGE_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CONFIRM_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CONFIRM_TIME, IVDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, IVDT.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS SELLER_ITEM_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY AS GR_QTY, #{IVK_QTY} AS INV_QTY, PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1',(SELECT NVL(STC_SELLER_PRICE,0) FROM WMSSTCK WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE=#{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = #{STDCATLG_ID} AND PROCESS_TYPE = '1'),NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0)) AS LIST_PRICE, ROUND(#{IVK_QTY} * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0)) AS UNIT_AMT, ROUND(#{IVK_QTY} * DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1',(SELECT NVL(STC_SELLER_PRICE,0) FROM WMSSTCK WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE=#{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID =#{STDCATLG_ID} AND PROCESS_TYPE = '1'),NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0))) AS LIST_AMT, PODT.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE, PODT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','KRKORE0001','2',POHD.AGENT,'3',PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE) AS AGENT, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_NO AS S_INV_NO, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS S_INV_SEQ, PODT.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO, PODT.PR_NO AS PR_NO, PODT.PR_SEQ AS PR_SEQ, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_DATE, IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, #{IVK_DATE} AS INV_DATE, 0 AS DELIVERY_QTY, '' AS DELIVERY_DATE, #{st_user_id} AS ADD_USER_ID, #{st_user_id} AS CHANGE_USER_ID, '' AS DELIVERY_USER_ID, #{LEGACY_IV_SERIAL}, '' AS DELIVERY_COMPANY, '' AS DELIVERY_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS CMS_CATELG_ID, NVL(#{SCHEDULED_DATE},F_GET_WORKINGDAY(to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD'),1)) AS SCHEDULED_DATE, #{CAR_ID}, #{CAR_NO}, #{CAR_PERSON_NAME}, #{CAR_PERSON_TEL}, #{BOX_QTY}, '' DELIVERY_PERSON, IVDT.TAG_NO AS TAG_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE PODT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PODT.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND PODT.PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ} AND IVDT.INV_NO =#{INV_NO} AND IVDT.INV_SEQ =#{INV_SEQ} AND PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ
AND IVDT.SELLER = IVHD.SELLER AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = IVHD.INV_NO
AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVHD.STATUS <> 'D' )
mapper.select: /* selectMasterWmGiReleaseTransPopList */ SELECT PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',(NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)),(NVL(PODT.ITEM_QTY,0)-NVL(PODT.IV_QTY,0))) AS WMS_GW_QTY, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS IVK_DATE, PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, DECODE(#{st_hub_yn}, 'Y', (SELECT HUB_GR_QTY FROM HUBIVDT WHERE BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND S_INV_SEQ = IVDT.INV_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D'), DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, '2', IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY, (SELECT AVAIL_QTY FROM WMSSTCK WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AND AGENT = DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, '1', 'KRKORE0001', '3', PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE))) ) AS WMS_GR_QTY, PODT.IV_QTY AS IV_QTY, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.UNIT_PRICE * (NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) AS WMS_IVK_AMT, PODT.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_NO AS INV_NO, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS INV_SEQ, (SELECT DOC_TYPE FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER= PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO=PODT.PO_NO) AS DOC_TYPE, DECODE((SELECT MAX(DOC_TYPE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO), 'X', (SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, F_GET_WORKINGDAY(to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD'),1) AS SCHEDULED_DATE, CASE WHEN IVDT.BOX_QTY IS NULL OR IVDT.BOX_QTY = 0 THEN 1 ELSE IVDT.BOX_QTY END AS BOX_QTY, IVDT.CAR_ID, IVDT.CAR_NO, IVDT.CAR_PERSON_NAME, IVDT.CAR_PERSON_TEL, PODT.DELAY_REMARK, ( SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE ='KRFAGB0002' AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000054' --K TAG : ? ) AS KTAG_USE_FLAG, F_GET_MSDS_INFO(PODT.BUYER, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,1) AS MSDS_NO, DECODE(#{st_hub_yn}, 'Y', INV_QTY, 0) AS IVK_QTY FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE PODT.BUYER = #{st_BUYER} AND PODT.PO_NO = #{st_PO_NO} AND IVDT.INV_NO = #{st_INV_NO} AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY WMS_GW_QTY DESC, PODT.BUYER, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ
/*selectMasterWmIyangLogisHawb*/ SELECT DECODE(COUNT(CODE1),0,'N','Y') AS IY_SEND_YN FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'IYUR' AND COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.CODE1 = #{BUYER} AND COD.FLAG = 'Y'
/*selectHanjinSendYn*/ SELECT DECODE(COUNT(CODE1),0,'N','Y') AS HJ_SEND_YN FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'HJUR' AND COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.CODE1 = #{BUYER} AND COD.FLAG = 'Y'
mapper.update: /*insertMasterWmIyangLogisHawb*/ INSERT INTO KEP_COURIER_MNG ( BUYER , INV_NO , BOX_SEQ , COURIER_NO , SENDER_POINT_CODE , SENDER_POINT_NAME , SENDER_NAME , SENDER_PHONE_NUMBER , SENDER_ZIP_CODE , SENDER_ADDRESS , RECEIVER_POINT_CODE , RECEIVER_POINT_NAME , ADD_DATE , ADD_USER_ID , IF_FLAG ) SELECT #{BUYER} , #{INV_NO} , #{BOX_SEQ} , (SELECT F_GET_SEQ('SEQ_ILYANGLOGIS') FROM DUAL) AS COURIER_NO , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'IYPC' AND COD.CODE = USR.ZIP_CODE) AS SENDER_POINT_CODE , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'IYPC' AND COD.CODE = USR.ZIP_CODE) AS SENDER_POINT_NAME , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001') AS COM_NAME , USR.PHONE_NUMBER , USR.ZIP_CODE , (SELECT COD2.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.TYPE ='C012' AND COD2.COMPANY_CODE ='KRKORE0001' AND COD2.FLAG ='Y' AND CODE = (SELECT DELY_TO_LOCATION FROM ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE LUSR.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID)) AS SENDER_ADDRESS , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'IYPC' AND COD.CODE IN ( SELECT SUBSTR(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,0,5) FROM ICOMPOHD POHD WHERE POHD.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND POHD.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} )) AS RECEIVER_POINT_CODE , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'IYPC' AND COD.CODE IN ( SELECT SUBSTR(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,0,5) FROM ICOMPOHD POHD WHERE POHD.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND POHD.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} )) AS RECEIVER_POINT_NAME , SYSDATE , #{USER_ID} , 'N' FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{USER_ID}

/*insertHanjinHd*/ INSERT INTO KEP_PARCEL_HJ ( CUSTEDICD, SVCCATCD, CUSTORDNO, WBLNO, CNTRACTNO, PICKUPASKDT, SNDRZIP, SNDRBASEADDR, SNDRDTLADDR, SNDRNM, SNDRTELNO, RCVRZIP, RCVRBASEADDR, RCVRDTLADDR, RCVRNM, RCVRTELNO, RCVRMOBILENO, RCVRASKCNTENT, RCVRREFCNTENT, PAYTYPCD, BOXTYPCD, COMODITYNM, IF_FLAG ) SELECT 'KORB2B' AS CUSTEDICD, 'S' AS SVCCATCD, A.BUYER||A.INV_NO AS CUSTORDNO, (SELECT F_GET_SEQ('SEQ_HANJINLOGIS') FROM DUAL) AS WBLNO, '6479237' AS CNTRACTNO, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS PICKUPASKDT, F.ZIP_CODE AS SNDRZIP, F.ADDRESS_LOC AS SNDRBASEADDR, NVL(F.ADDRESS_LOC2,'.') AS SNDRDTLADDR, F.COM_NAME_LOC AS SNDRNM, F.TEL_NO AS SNDRTELNO, TRIM(SUBSTR(C.DELY_TO_LOCATION,1,6)) AS RCVRZIP, TRIM(SUBSTRB(SUBSTR(C.DELY_TO_LOCATION,7),1,100)) AS RCVRBASEADDR, -- 바이트 초과 문제 수정 NVL(TRIM(SUBSTRB(SUBSTR(C.DELY_TO_LOCATION,7),101,100)),'.') AS RCVRDTLADDR, NVL(TRIM(D.RECIPIENT_NAME), E.USER_NAME_LOC) AS RCVRNM, NVL(TRIM(D.RECIPIENT_PHONE), E.PHONE_NUMBER) AS RCVRTELNO, NVL(TRIM(D.RECIPIENT_PHONE), E.MOBILE_PHONE) AS RCVRMOBILENO, SUBSTRB(C.PO_REMARK,1,150) AS RCVRASKCNTENT, E.USER_NAME_LOC AS RCVRREFCNTENT, 'CD' AS PAYTYPCD, 'A' AS BOXTYPCD, C.PO_NO || ', ' || A.S_INV_NO || ', ' || B.DESCRIPTION AS COMODITYNM, 'N' AS IF_FLAG FROM WMSIVDT A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMPOHD C, ICOMPRDT D, ICOMLUSR E, ICOMCMPY F, ICOMPRHD G WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND B.BUYER = D.BUYER AND B.PR_NO = D.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = D.PR_SEQ AND D.STATUS != 'D' AND D.REQ_USER_ID = E.USER_ID AND C.BUYER = E.COM_CODE AND D.BUYER = G.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = G.PR_NO AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE = F.COM_CODE AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.select: /*selectHanjinItemHdLst*/ SELECT CUSTEDICD, SVCCATCD, CUSTORDNO, WBLNO, CNTRACTNO, PICKUPASKDT, SNDRZIP, SNDRBASEADDR, SNDRDTLADDR, SNDRNM, SNDRTELNO, RCVRZIP, RCVRBASEADDR, RCVRDTLADDR, RCVRNM, RCVRTELNO, RCVRMOBILENO, RCVRASKCNTENT, RCVRREFCNTENT, PAYTYPCD, BOXTYPCD, COMODITYNM FROM KEP_PARCEL_HJ WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND CUSTORDNO = #{BUYER}||#{INV_NO}
mapper.update: /*updateHanjinParcelLb*/ INSERT INTO KEP_PARCEL_HJ_LB ( RESULT_CODE, RESULT_MESSAGE, MSG_KEY, MSG_SEQ, S_TML_NAM, S_TML_COD, ZIP_COD, TML_NAM, TML_COD, CEN_NAM, CEN_COD, PD_TIM, DOM_RGN, HUB_COD, DOM_MID, ES_COD, GRP_RNK, ES_NAM, PRT_ADD, PARCEL_NO ) VALUES ( #{result_code}, #{result_message}, #{msg_key}, #{msg_seq}, #{s_tml_nam}, #{s_tml_cod}, #{zip_cod}, #{tml_nam}, #{tml_cod}, #{cen_nam}, #{cen_cod}, #{pd_tim}, #{dom_rgn}, #{hub_cod}, #{dom_mid}, #{es_cod}, #{grp_rnk}, #{es_nam}, #{prt_add}, #{parcelNo} )
